sources.purpose: Stage 1 ground detail subset: wet soil / forest floor / muddy shore surface frequency for the terrain macro treatment. The plan's named pick for Stage 1.
sources.variantNote: 1K-PNG chosen over the smaller 1K-JPG so the pipeline needs no JPEG decoder and no lossy-recompression step; the ZIP is cache-only and never shipped.

sources.author: Greg Zaal
sources.purpose: Stage 1 environment: overcast, low-contrast autumn IBL/sky reference. Reduced to SH radiance + hemisphere colours + a tone-mapped preview; the raw HDR is never shipped.
sources.variantNote: 1K HDR is the plan's pick. Poly Haven publishes md5 c0f556c01d12120169b916b0b4c3efc1 for this file; the pipeline additionally pins sha256.

outputs.purpose: Terrain ground-detail base colour, tiled in world space. Muted by the material table's baseColor factor, not baked in.
Terrain ground-detail normal (OpenGL +Y convention, matching deck.gl/luma.gl). Supplies surface frequency without runtime displacement.
Packed occlusion/roughness/metalness. R = AO, G = roughness, B = metalness (constant 0 for ground). One sampler instead of three.
Tone-mapped equirectangular sky/ambient reference for the realistic background and for eyeballing the environment tint. Not a runtime IBL source.
8x128 vertical strip of the HDRI's average colour per elevation band; drop-in background gradient texture, zenith at the top.

9 SH radiance coefficients (unconvolved projection L_lm — multiply band l by A_l = [pi, 2pi/3, pi/4] for Lambertian irradiance), hemisphere/zenith/horizon averages, and the estimated dominant-light direction. Ambient reference only: the key light stays pinned by src/render-style.js.

Self-authored seamless breakup tile. R = low-frequency macro tint (hides 1K repetition across Woods), G = mid-frequency wetness/grime mask, B = high-frequency detail, A = 16x16 Bayer dither threshold for LOD cross-fades.

Self-authored 16x16x16 colour-grade LUT (256x16 horizontal strip, blue slices left to right) for the combined post pass: desaturate, cool the shadows toward the fog colour, warm the highlights slightly.

toolchain.textureFormatTodo: TODO(stage-1-renderer): switch the material set to KTX2/Basis once the renderer carries a transcoder. Measured with `--ktx2-report` using ktx2-encoder@0.6.0 (pure wasm, no native build, byte-identical across runs): the three 512px ground maps drop from 1.43 MiB PNG to 0.45 MiB KTX2 (69% smaller) — albedo 487->72 KiB ETC1S, normal 542->323 KiB UASTC+zstd, ORM 435->66 KiB ETC1S. Not shipped now because nothing in this checkout can decode KTX2 at runtime; wiring @loaders.gl/textures plus a basis transcoder is a renderer change owned by the Stage 1 renderer branch, not by the asset pipeline.
